reasons: query1 multiplies tup_inserted by a constant 100, which is not in the Datadog source; the hard rules forbid applying numeric constants, so any unit scale must be proposed in notes only.

Template variables with prefixes are dropped. $db (prefix db), $host (prefix host) and $table (prefix table) should become matchers on the dataset labels (postgresql_database_name, host_name, postgresql_table_name), so the candidate selects a different set of series than the Datadog request.
The $scope variable has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct.
Grouping by db maps to postgresql_database_name, which is observed in the dataset, so the grouping is ok.
Metric mapping (rows_inserted/updated/deleted to tup_inserted/updated/deleted, rate on monotonic sums) is plausible, and the outcome is translated as expected.
